summary: Round 6 (r6b3). Best eval 98.276 (CP7, 0 finishes; incumbent 98.349). MILESTONE: NEW --respawn-front (spawn rows from the 2 s before real training episodes reach the frontier, kept even if they die; + --respawn-front-advance / -cross / -finish refinements) gave the first REAL training finish of the lineage at 17.74B (~322M steps after the incumbent): basement hole -> the room's east slope -> over the funnel's east rim -> shaft. The greedy line never followed in ~1.4B more steps: it reaches the basement in ~20% of eval episodes and climbs (rarely) only after energy-wasting loops (E ~1,400 vs ~1,600+ needed at the east slope top); even the sampled policy cannot repeat its own crossings from their starts (0/24). Nulls: --respawn-greedy-speed 1-2, SIL (all R>V rows, and --sil-success: finishing episodes only) both hurt the line; frontier share 0.4 regressed the main line. Final arm: r6b3_front7 (front config, evals every 6.25M).
